description:
Free Health Camp at Mauli Clinic, Hamrapur

Today, on 8th September 2026, a Free Health Camp was successfully organized at Mauli Clinic, Hamrapur.

During the camp, valuable information was provided regarding blood pressure, blood sugar, diabetes, its prevention and management, and the importance of a healthy and appropriate diet.

A total of 78 patients received free blood sugar testing, and free treatment was initiated for those who required medical care.

Additionally, 45 patients were examined for high blood pressure (hypertension) and appropriate treatment was started.

The camp was successfully conducted with the valuable support and cooperation of all the members of the Rotary Club of Manor Highway.

Thank you, Rotary Club of Manor Highway, for your valuable support and cooperation in making this health camp a success. 🙏

Mauli Clinic, Hamrapur
Dr. Rahul Naresh Patil
